01 / About me

A story of ambition, skill and purpose.

I am Alhaji Mamadu Allieu Barrie, known professionally as Barrie Scott. I was born in Bo City, Sierra Leone. My interests bring together practical craftsmanship, creativity, business ideas and a desire to motivate young people.

Education & training

My background includes university education and vocational welding training. I began learning welding in 2020 and received my welding certificate in 2025 from the Sierra Leone Opportunities Industrialisation Centres (SLOIC). My practical specialism is arc welding.

My vision

My dream is to succeed in life and become one of the best welders Sierra Leone has ever produced. Beyond welding, I aim to develop a fashion business, grow as a content creator and use motivational speaking to encourage young Africans.
